description: A tracker’s headline figures as its own page prints them, with the date they are true as of, read exactly as the site’s assistant reads them: projects and capacity by stage, and by country for the GCC, Regional and World Renewables Trackers. tracker: saudi-renewables (stages as the page counts them, the Principal Buyer’s register leading where it differs), gcc-renewables, regional-renewables, world-renewables (the flagship projects of every other country), captive-solar, data-centres (Saudi: the 2024 baseline, the flagship records by status and the 2030 scenarios), ccus (capture Mt CO2 a year by stage), storage, hydrogen, water.
